projectName: Found by AI — Tech Horizon Labs
projectDescription: Found by AI measures and improves how often AI assistants name your business when buyers ask questions, using a 7-engine visibility layer, a GEO readiness score, MCP integration, and an open-source Claude Code skill suite.
keyFeatures: 7-engine AI visibility measurement (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Grok, DeepSeek, Google AI Overviews)
Composite GEO Readiness Score (0–100) across 6 weighted dimensions
MCP server integration for AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini)
Live areyoufoundbyai.com scan API — free tier, no auth required
Open-source Claude Code skill suite (17 skills, npx installable)
Branded PDF audit reports via audit-report-kit (TypeScript/React PDF)
Agency Fleet plan with white-label reports and scoped client keys
Free tools: AI crawler checker, DNS-AID checker, IndexNow submitter, llms.txt generator, JSON-LD schema generator
AI traffic beacon for measuring AI-driven site visits
Majority-voted sampling across multiple scan runs for statistical accuracy
Australian, UK, and US benchmark indexes (3,800+ businesses measured)
Verbatim answer receipts showing exactly what each AI engine said
publicApiSurface: POST https://areyoufoundbyai.com/api/scan — run a visibility + readiness scan
claude mcp add --transport http found-by-ai https://areyoufoundbyai.com/mcp/demo
npx skills add techhorizonlabs/thl-open — install Claude Code skill suite
MCP tool: scan_website(url) — trigger a fresh scan
MCP tool: get_visibility_score(url) — retrieve latest visibility score
MCP tool: get_readiness_score(url) — retrieve latest readiness score
MCP tool: get_fixes(url) — retrieve prioritised fix list
MCP tool: get_verbatim_answers(url, engine) — retrieve raw AI engine answers
MCP tool: list_competitors(url) — retrieve competitor share-of-voice
skills/found-by-ai SKILL.md — Claude Code wrapper for areyoufoundbyai.com API
skills/agent-readiness-scan scan_to_csv.py — convert JSON scan to CSV
tools/audit-report-kit CLI: npm run report — generate branded PDF + JSON-LD
geo-audit skill: /geo audit <url> — 5-subagent parallel GEO audit
geo-llmstxt skill: validate and generate llms.txt
geo-schema skill: detect, validate, and generate Schema.org JSON-LD
